: 
G.A. 
Court No. - 12

Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J. 
1.
Rejoinder affidavit is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

None has appeared for the informant despite notice.
3.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.217 of 2024, under Section 376(AB), 504, 506 IPC & Section 5m/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Hardi, District Bahraich.
4. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant aged about four years had gone to an agricultural field when the applicant caught hold of her and committed wrong on her.
Age of the victim is around 4 years.
Medical on record corroborates the allegation.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
6. Considering the grievous offence committed by the applicant duly corroborated by the medical on record, no good ground for bail is made out.
7. Present bail application is accordingly rejected.
8. The applicant would be at liberty to apply for fresh bail after the statement of the victim and the statement of the medical officer is recorded.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) November 6, 2025 nishant  Muneem Kumar @ Munnam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...
